dogecoin.text: Crypto currency is trending because Dogecoin, so I think it's a great time to remind everyone how awful crypto is for the environment. For example, Bitcoin's annual energy consumption is comparable to that of the entire country of Argentina or Ukraine. https://t.co/RNoCF3A169
